subject: mathematics
content: A man on the top of a vertical tower observes a car moving at a uniform speed towards the tower on a horizontal road. If it takes 18 min. for the angle of depression of the car to change from 30<sup>o</sup> to 45<sup>o</sup> ; then after this, the time taken (in min.) by the car to reach the foot of the tower, is :
